3490-4289-7075-8296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-7075-8296.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6094-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

934-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
934-4881-6909-8200.easyPrerequisites: Amorphous Axe is attached to Carnage.
934-4881-6909-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

147-653-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-6798.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6798-6972-7936.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1011-2728-5231-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5231-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5231-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

851-4772-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-6558-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-6558-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-6558-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1494-7435-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Hardened Academic by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

719-3967-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-3967-4302.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2092-2757-3213-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Boromir from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Boromir, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Boromir by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

803-5256-5659-6482.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Avenging Angel.
When Avenging Angel dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Avenging Angel's power, which will cause you to mill Avenging Angel.
As Avenging Angel is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Avenging Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2079-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-2642-4050-7546.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Inspired Skypainter // Maestro's Gift, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat.

3963-4377-5531.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
3963-4377-5531.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-4377-5531.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using Meneldor.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

628-997-7211.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

1718-2510-6072-7182.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1718-2510-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Semblance Anvil.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Semblance Anvil.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
1718-2510-6072-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

141-2292-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

4699-5073-5220-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

549-4659-5346-6520.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
549-4659-5346-6520.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
549-4659-5346-6520.description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {2}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Nemesis Phoenix dies, Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2182-3858-6519.description:
Cast Mutated Cultist by paying {2}{B}. Mutated Cultist triggers, removing all ice counters from Dark Depths.
Dark Depths triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create a 20/20 Marit Lage legendary creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to  put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with an opponent chosen

1055-5230-6497.description:
Declare Terisian Mindbreaker as an attacker attacking the opponent named by Sewer Nemesis. Terisian Mindbreaker triggers, causing the opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Sewer Nemesis by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in their graveyard, milling the remainder of their library.

650-710-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

1818-3097-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.

7-413-708-2500-2931.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with a +1/+1 counter on them.
7-413-708-2500-2931.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
When Faceless One enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to return Faceless One to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

732-3729.description:
During your untap step, Felhide Spiritbinder is untapped.
During your upkeep step, Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Ondu Spiritdancer with haste.
When the token Ondu Spiritdancer enters the battlefield, the nontoken Ondu Spiritdancer triggers, causing you to create a copy of the Ondu Spiritdancer token.
When the new token Ondu Spiritdancer enters the battlefield, the previous token Ondu Spiritdancer triggers, causing you to create a copy of the new Ondu Spiritdancer token.
Repeat step 4.

147-4050-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4050-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4050-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

2825-3263-3298-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two Goblins.
2825-3263-3298-3525.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brightstone Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Brightstone Ritual, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

215-2635-3717.notablePrerequisites:
You have a green creature card in hand with mana value equal to seven.
Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana to cast the creature card in hand, minus {1}.
215-2635-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to Viridian Joiner's power.
Cast any creature card in your hand with mana value seven by paying its mana cost.
Raggadragga's second ability triggers, untapping Viridian Joiner and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the green creature with mana value seven from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-2896.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Necromancy until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Necromancy triggers, causing you to sacrifice Abdel Adrian.
Necromancy returns to the battlefield, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Repeat from step 2.

413-796-1762.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
413-796-1762.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
